Service 02 • Academics & Careers

Education Consultant & Placement in Jharkhand & West Bengal

Empowering students and job seekers with authentic admission guidance, personalized career counselling, and verified job placement support.

From Campus to Career

Your Pathway to Top Universities & Corporate Careers

Choosing the right academic course and securing genuine job opportunities shouldn't be left to guesswork. GB Group works directly with accredited colleges, universities, and corporate recruiters to ensure seamless admissions and fruitful career placements for students in Jharkhand and West Bengal.

100% Genuine Guidance: Transparent fees, recognized degrees, and direct admission counselling.
Corporate Placement Support: Resume preparation, interview training, and placement drives.

1. Course & College/University Guidance

We provide students with in-depth evaluation and counselling to pick the course that matches their skills and market demand:

  • Engineering & Technology: B.Tech, M.Tech, Polytechnic & Diploma (Computer Science, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical).
  • Management & Commerce: MBA, PGDM, BBA, B.Com (Finance, Marketing, HR, Business Analytics).
  • Computer Applications & IT: BCA, MCA, Data Science, and Cloud Computing specializations.
  • Healthcare & Allied Sciences: B.Pharma, D.Pharma, B.Sc Nursing, Paramedical courses.
  • Law, Design & Humanities: BA LLB, BBA LLB, Hotel Management, Mass Communication.

2. Admission Help

We remove the uncertainty and documentation hassle from the admission process:

  • Guidance for state & national entrance tests, counselling rounds, and quota criteria.
  • Assistance with application forms, document verification, and eligibility checks.
  • Direct admission coordination in UGC, AICTE, and PCI-approved institutions.
  • Education loan assistance and scholarship guidance for eligible students.
  • Guidance for students from Jharkhand seeking top colleges in West Bengal and vice versa.

3. Career Counselling

Personalized mentoring to help students and working professionals define actionable career roadmaps:

  • One-on-one sessions analyzing strengths, interests, and academic performance.
  • Insights into high-growth industry sectors and in-demand future skills.
  • Overcoming confusion between multiple career paths or course options.
  • Post-graduate and international education pathway exploration.

4. Job Placement Support

We bridge the gap between fresh graduates, skilled professionals, and leading employers:

  • Corporate recruitment tie-ups across IT, Manufacturing, Retail, BFSI, and Logistics.
  • Professional resume formatting and LinkedIn profile enhancement.
  • Mock interviews, group discussion (GD) coaching, and soft skills training.
  • Direct referral to active hiring openings across Kolkata, Ranchi, and pan-India.
